messages:
marcos: Quick heads-up — we need a migration safety-net for v4 streaming frames. A handful of customers hit broken clients during the last canary.
anya: yep saw that. We can't force rollout immediately. Thinking: a lightweight shim that 1) accepts v4, 2) detects legacy clients via header or user-agent, 3) emits v3-compatible frames.
devon: would that be in the edge proxy or runtime?
anya: prefer edge proxy so runtime stays minimal. shim at the gate is easier to toggle/rollback.
sam: edge shim makes sense but beware of async ordering differences — v4 uses explicit chunk types (meta/patch/end) vs v3 just streamed text. We need to map carefully.
ken: +1. Also add a circuit-breaker: if shim errors > N per minute, fail-open to runtime v4 and emit telemetry.
marcos: Agreed on telemetry. We need events: compat_shim/accept, compat_shim/translate, compat_shim/fail, client_detected=legacy. Keep payloads small.
anya: Implementation sketch: detect header `X-Compat-Version: v3` or fallback to `User-Agent` sniffing. Pseudocode:```if (hdr=="v3") translate_v4_frames_to_v3(stream) else pass_through()```
devon: For translation rules: join consecutive `text` frames into a single chunk, drop `meta` frames or translate into inline comments, and ensure `EOF` -> final chunk. Edge cases: partial tokens and tokenization boundaries might change latency.
sam: Can we add a short-lived prefix caching rule so common prompts don't re-stream entire context for legacy clients? Might help latency.
ken: Need to sync rollout with client teams (support/SDK). Otherwise we'll mask bugs and make users dependent on shim. Propose opt-in for 2 months, then deprecate.
marcos: rollout plan suggestion: 1) deploy shim to staging 2) enable for 5% of canary tenants + internal SDK tests 3) monitor compat_shim/* metrics and error budget for 72h 4) 25% -> 100% over 2 weeks if stable. Fallback flag: `compat.shim.enabled=false` per-tenant.
anya: ops note: we should surface shim-translation latencies in the Console per-route. Add a trace tag `shim_translation_ms`.
deploy-bot: deploy started — compat-shim service to staging cluster (commit 9f3b2a). :rocket:
devon: question on billing — translated responses may change token counts. How do we surface charge attribution?
marcos: track both original tokens and translated tokens as separate telemetry fields: `tokens_in`, `tokens_out_translated`. Product can decide billing policy (we'll default to `tokens_in`).
san: small nit: name the header `X-RW-Compat` instead of generic `X-Compat-Version` so third-party proxies don't accidentally set it.
ken: good call. Also add a tenant opt-out via header `X-RW-Compat: none` for QA teams.
anya: I'll draft an RFC for this shim (surface: placement, API detection rules, translation table, telemetry, rollout plan). Will include minimal code snippet for edge lua/transformation and a test harness.
marcos: Thanks — prioritize tests that validate token boundaries and streaming order. After RFC I'll open a runbook for rollback.
sam: +1. I'll coordinate SDK patch to emit `X-RW-Compat:v3` during our staged migration so we can track client opt-ins.
marcos: OK, next steps: @anya to write RFC; @sam to prepare SDK opt-in; @ken to own telemetry dashboards; @devon to prototype translation in the edge proxy. We'll sync end of day tomorrow. :thumbsup:
